sources: Attardo GTVH (Raskin+Attardo SSTH; Attardo 1994 Linguistic Theories of Humor; Attardo 2001 Humorous Texts)
meta.provenance_rule: Every node carries provenance: mined (from this repo's 2026-10-08 pass) or literature (standard GTVH inventory; verify against Humorous Texts ch.3 before banking new joke ids on literature-only nodes). Edges carry confidence: strong or plausible.
meta.note: FACS/AUBlendNet Table 2 is the authority for faces, not this file. This file is the authority for joke structure.

knowledge_resources.name: script_opposition
knowledge_resources.def: Two scripts that overlap on a span and oppose on at least one dimension. Highest KR; changing SO changes the joke. Abstract classes: actual/non-actual, normal/abnormal, possible/impossible (good/bad is the common extension).

knowledge_resources.name: logical_mechanism
knowledge_resources.def: The playful reasoning step connecting the two scripts. Optional: absent = absurd/no-resolution; partial = playful only. Ranked below SO: same LM can serve many oppositions.

knowledge_resources.name: situation
knowledge_resources.def: Participants, props, activity, macro-script (office, bar, interview). Carries backgrounded incongruities: suspend, never explicate.

knowledge_resources.name: target
knowledge_resources.def: Butt of the joke (person/group/institution/belief/null) + orientation (speaker/hearer/other/situation). ~2/3 of corpus jokes carry one; empty = non-tendentious. Routes to taboo-gates.

knowledge_resources.name: narrative_strategy
knowledge_resources.def: Surface arrangement: riddle-QA, 3-step-AAB, dialogue, list, trick-elicitation, knock-knock, anecdote-no-punch, one-liner. Arrangements, never premises.

knowledge_resources.name: language
knowledge_resources.def: Exact wording: punch disjunctor (forces reinterpretation), ambiguity type (lexical/syntactic/referential/pragmatic/paronym), register (solemn/familiar/professional). Lowest KR: rewordable without killing the joke.

logical_mechanisms.def: Lead audience to assume script A; punch forces reanalysis to B.
Treat disparate things as same on weak similarity.
Push a premise to its absurd literal consequence.
Incompatible scripts side by side, no connective.
AAB pattern plus break on the third.
Persist with a rule despite counter-evidence (automaton).
Utterance defeats itself; tu quoque recoil.
Treat similar sounds as similar meanings; puns and reanalysis.
Referential/structural ambiguity resolved at punch (disjunctor as connector).
Assert p and not-p across the jab/punch turn.
Incongruous imitation of a recognizable text/genre/register.
Say the opposite of what the situation warrants; audience inverts.

jab_line.def: Setup line carrying SO material without resolving it. Jabs can stack; each re-evokes the overlap span.

punch_line.def: Final line triggering the script switch. Position is criterial: move it and the text stops being a joke (vs anecdote).

disjunctor.def: Word/phrase forcing reinterpretation (punch trigger). Lives in KR.LA.

connector.def: Span readable under both scripts (the overlap). Lives in KR.SO.

strand.def: One jab->punch arc inside a longer text.

stack_sequence_combo.def: Strands chained (sequence), piled on one punch (stack), or braided (combo). Long-form unit for sets.

target_types.stat: target present in ~2/3 of corpus jokes
